scope: Actual Plot update loop, relaxed LLVM, one compressed loopback client; main thread pinned to logical CPU 24; writer and receiver unpinned. Compilation and complete-state verification untimed.
cadence: 10 Hz isolated fast-render cap; publication may wait for complete native batches. The user also permits lower publication rates.
timing: Loop TPS includes simulation, effects and live plot work. End-to-end TPS additionally includes queued command delivery and final ordered network barrier.
decision: Keep the production default at 16 ticks. Batch 32 showed modest IO gains but no consistent improvement without publication; short PM1 runs varied substantially. Batch 64 was slower on PM1. Output checks passed at every width.
limitations: One loopback client; no live server deployment or Minecraft renderer test. Client checks cover the latest published IO state and final reference outputs, not every intermediate game tick.
